subject: DI03005011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Pressure is normal force per area. Gauge pressure is relative to atmosphere, absolute pressure to vacuum, and differential pressure to a second applied pressure.

Detailed explanation and conditions

Choose range, overpressure rating, wetted-material compatibility, dynamic response and reference deliberately. A gauge connected through a liquid-filled impulse line can include a static head offset. A negative gauge pressure is a vacuum indication, not negative absolute pressure. Isolate, depressurize and verify before connecting or removing any gauge.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

એકમ area દીઠ normal force Pressure છે. Gauge pressure atmosphere સામે, absolute pressure vacuum સામે અને differential pressure બીજા applied pressure સામે લેવાય છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા Conditions

Range, overpressure rating, wetted-material compatibility, dynamic response તથા reference યોગ્ય પસંદ કરો. Liquid-filled impulse line static-head offset ઉમેરે છે. Negative gauge pressure vacuum indication છે, negative absolute pressure નહીં. Connection/removal પહેલાં isolate, depressurize તથા verify કરો.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

An elastic pressure gauge using deflection of a thin diaphragm.

Principle

Pressure difference across a flexible diaphragm produces displacement related to the applied pressure.

Construction

A circular metal or compatible diaphragm is clamped around its rim between pressure and reference spaces. A process port admits pressure to one face; the opposite face is exposed to the selected reference. A central pushrod and lever amplify motion to a pointer or displacement transducer. The case and stops protect the mechanism; material and diaphragm thickness/corrugation set sensitivity and range.

Working

Process pressure acts over the effective diaphragm area and deflects its centre against elastic stiffness. The pushrod transmits this small movement to a linkage that moves the calibrated pointer. When pressure falls, the diaphragm returns elastically within its rated range. With an atmospheric reference the reading is gauge pressure; changing the reference changes what pressure is indicated, not the diaphragm principle itself.

Applications

Low-to-moderate pressures and compatible process service; appropriate sealed designs suit difficult fluids.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Overload causes permanent deformation; temperature, corrosion and hysteresis affect accuracy. Use compatible wetted materials and rated overload protection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Thin diaphragm ના elastic deflection વડે pressure માપતું gauge છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Flexible diaphragm ની બંને બાજુના pressure difference થી displacement થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Circular diaphragm rim પર pressure/reference spaces વચ્ચે clamp થાય છે. Process port એક face પર pressure આપે છે અને બીજું selected reference પર હોય છે. Central pushrod તથા lever motion ને pointer/transducer સુધી amplify કરે છે. Case/stops mechanism protect કરે છે. Material, thickness તથા corrugation થી sensitivity/range નક્કી થાય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Pressure effective area પર લાગતાં diaphragm centre elastic stiffness સામે deflect થાય છે. Pushrod motion ને linkage દ્વારા calibrated pointer સુધી પહોંચાડે છે. Pressure ઘટતાં rated range માં diaphragm પાછું આવે છે. Atmospheric reference હોય તો gauge pressure મળે છે. Reference બદલવાથી pressure basis બદલાય છે, diaphragm principle નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Low-to-moderate pressure તથા compatible process service; યોગ્ય sealed designs difficult fluids માટે ઉપયોગી છે.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Overload થી permanent deformation થાય છે. Temperature, corrosion તથા hysteresis errors લાવે છે. Compatible material તથા rated overload protection લો.

body.en:
Definition

A mechanical gauge using the elastic uncoiling of a curved, noncircular-section tube.

Principle

Internal pressure tends to round the flattened cross-section and straighten the curved tube.

Construction

A C-shaped flattened metal tube has a fixed socket end connected to the process and a sealed free tip. The tip connects through a link to a sector gear, pinion and pointer. A dial and protective case surround the movement. The drawing shows the fixed pressure inlet, free tip and gearing; spiral/helical forms provide other ranges and motion characteristics.

Working

Pressure entering the fixed end acts throughout the tube and changes its section/curvature. The free tip moves outward and the link rotates the sector and pointer. When pressure decreases, tube elasticity returns the tip and indication toward zero. The movement is small before mechanical amplification. Pulsating service may require a correctly selected snubber or liquid-filled gauge; these do not authorize exceeding the pressure rating.

Applications

General industrial positive-pressure indication over suitable medium/high ranges.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Poor for very small pressure differences; fatigue, overpressure, temperature and corrosion cause errors. Check range, wetted alloy and safe case construction.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Curved noncircular-section tube ના elastic uncoiling વડે pressure માપતું mechanical gauge છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Internal pressure flattened section ને વધુ round કરીને curved tube ને straighten કરવાની tendency આપે છે.

રચના (Construction)

C-shaped flattened metal tube નો socket end fixed તથા process સાથે જોડાયેલો છે. Sealed free tip link, sector gear, pinion તથા pointer સાથે જોડાય છે. Dial તથા protective case હોય છે. Drawing fixed inlet, free tip તથા gears બતાવે છે. Spiral/helical forms અન્ય ranges/motion આપે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Fixed end માં આવતું pressure tube ના section/curvature બદલે છે. Free tip બહાર ખસે છે અને link/sector pointer ફેરવે છે. Pressure ઘટતાં elasticity tip/indication ને zero તરફ લાવે છે. Amplification પહેલાં motion નાનું હોય છે. Pulsating service માટે suitable snubber/liquid-filled gauge લઈ શકાય, પણ pressure rating exceed કરવાની છૂટ મળતી નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable medium/high ranges માં સામાન્ય industrial positive-pressure indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

નાના pressure differences માટે sensitivity ઓછી છે. Fatigue, overpressure, temperature તથા corrosion થી error થાય છે. Range, wetted alloy તથા safe case construction તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A pressure-standard device balancing fluid pressure against known force on a calibrated piston area.

Principle

At floating equilibrium, pressure times effective piston area balances the applied load.

Construction

A precision vertical piston fits a cylinder connected through clean pressure fluid to a pump, reservoir and the gauge under test. Calibrated masses load a carrier on the piston. A level base and a means to adjust pressure keep the piston within its floating region. The mass of piston/carrier is part of the load when specified. Fluid compatibility and effective-area calibration are essential.

Working

Apply the chosen calibrated load and raise pressure slowly until the piston floats at its operating height. Gently rotate it if the manufacturer requires this to reduce friction. Read the test gauge after stabilization and compare with the reference pressure. Repeat increasing and decreasing points to assess error/hysteresis. In precise work use calibrated effective area, local gravity, air buoyancy, temperature and head corrections rather than assuming mass/nominal area alone is exact.

Applications

Calibration of compatible pressure gauges and transmitters.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Not a rapid fluctuating-process indicator. Keep piston clean, level and within travel; never add/remove connections under pressure.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Calibrated piston area પર known force ને fluid pressure સાથે balance કરતું pressure-standard device છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Floating equilibrium પર pressure×effective piston area applied load ને balance કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Precision vertical piston cylinder માં fit થાય છે. Clean pressure fluid મારફતે pump, reservoir તથા gauge-under-test જોડાય છે. Calibrated masses piston carrier પર મૂકાય છે. Level base તથા pressure adjustment થી piston floating region માં રહે છે. Specified હોય ત્યારે piston/carrier mass load માં ગણાય છે. Fluid compatibility તથા effective-area calibration જરૂરી છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Calibrated load મૂકીને piston operating height પર float થાય ત્યાં સુધી ધીમે pressure વધારો. Manufacturer કહે તો friction ઘટાડવા gently rotate કરો. Stabilize થયા પછી test gauge reading reference pressure સાથે compare કરો. Increasing/decreasing points લો. Precise work માં effective area, local gravity, air buoyancy, temperature તથા head corrections લો; mass/nominal area ને exact ન માનો.

ઉપયોગો

Compatible pressure gauges તથા transmitters નું calibration.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Rapid fluctuating-process indication માટે નથી. Piston clean/level અને travel limits માં રાખો. Pressure હેઠળ connection ન બદલશો.

body.en:
Definition

A pressure instrument converting elastic strain into a resistance change and electrical output.

Principle

A bonded strain element changes resistance when the pressure-sensing member deforms. A bridge detects the small change.

Construction

A pressure diaphragm or elastic member carries bonded metallic strain gauges in selected tensile/compressive regions. Gauges connect as arms of a Wheatstone bridge with excitation and differential output terminals. An amplifier/transmitter and temperature compensation condition the signal. The gauge foil must follow the member strain without slipping; the pressure diaphragm remains the wetted mechanical boundary.

Working

Applied pressure bends the diaphragm and strains the bonded elements. Their resistance changes unbalance the energized bridge. The differential voltage is amplified and calibrated as pressure. Compensating and active bridge arrangements reduce temperature effects when correctly designed. The gauge senses strain, not pressure independently; its pressure calibration depends on diaphragm geometry, bonding, bridge arrangement and reference pressure.

Applications

Remote pressure recording, transmitters and dynamic measurement with suitable electronics.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Requires excitation and compensation; bond creep, overload, moisture ingress and electrical noise matter.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Elastic strain ને resistance change તથા electrical output માં ફેરવતું pressure instrument છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Pressure-sensing member deform થાય ત્યારે bonded strain element ની resistance બદલાય છે. Bridge નાનો change detect કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Pressure diaphragm/elastic member ના tensile/compressive regions પર metallic strain gauges bond થાય છે. Gauges Wheatstone bridge ના arms તરીકે excitation તથા differential output સાથે જોડાય છે. Amplifier/transmitter તથા temperature compensation signal condition કરે છે. Foil member ની strain અનુસરવી જોઈએ. Pressure diaphragm wetted mechanical boundary છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Applied pressure diaphragm bend કરીને gauges strain કરે છે. Resistance changes થી energized bridge unbalance થાય છે. Differential voltage amplify કરીને pressure તરીકે calibrate થાય છે. યોગ્ય compensating/active bridge design temperature effects ઘટાડે છે. Gauge પોતે strain sense કરે છે; pressure calibration geometry, bonding, bridge તથા reference પર આધારિત છે.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable electronics સાથે remote pressure recording, transmitters તથા dynamic measurement.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Excitation/compensation જોઈએ. Bond creep, overload, moisture ingress તથા electrical noise મહત્વનાં છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A sensitive elastic gauge using two joined diaphragms forming a hollow capsule.

Principle

A pressure difference expands or contracts the capsule axially.

Construction

Two thin, often corrugated circular diaphragms are welded or sealed around their periphery. A connection admits pressure to the capsule interior while the outside sees the reference. A centre linkage amplifies capsule motion to a pointer. Stacking suitable capsules can increase travel. The walls, seal and stop mechanism are designed for small differential pressures, not arbitrary process overpressure.

Working

As internal pressure rises relative to the surrounding reference, the two flexible walls move apart. The moving centre drives the calibrated indication. When the difference decreases, elastic restoring force contracts the capsule. For the usual low-pressure dry-gas design, clean pressure passages keep the delicate element free from deposits. The exact polarity of movement depends on which pressure is applied inside.

Applications

Small gas pressures, draught and sensitive low-pressure indication.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Delicate and overload-sensitive; liquid contamination and condensation may be unsuitable for the selected design.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે joined diaphragms થી બનેલા hollow capsule વડે low pressure માપતું sensitive elastic gauge છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Pressure difference થી capsule axially expand/contract થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

બે thin, ઘણીવાર corrugated circular diaphragms periphery પર seal/weld થાય છે. Port capsule interior માં pressure આપે છે અને બહાર reference હોય છે. Centre linkage motion ને pointer સુધી amplify કરે છે. Suitable capsule stack travel વધારી શકે છે. Walls, seal તથા stops નાના differential pressure માટે designed છે, arbitrary overpressure માટે નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Internal pressure reference કરતાં વધતાં બે flexible walls દૂર થાય છે. Moving centre indication ચલાવે છે. Difference ઘટતાં restoring force capsule contract કરે છે. Usual low-pressure dry-gas design માં clean passages થી deposits અટકાવો. Inside કયું pressure આપ્યું છે તે પ્રમાણે movement polarity બદલાય છે.

ઉપયોગો

Small gas pressures, draught તથા sensitive low-pressure indication.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Delicate તથા overload-sensitive છે. Selected design માટે liquid contamination/condensation unsuitable હોઈ શકે છે.

body.en:
Definition

A pressure instrument referenced to a sealed evacuated space rather than local atmosphere.

Principle

A sensing element responds to process pressure minus a very low, known reference pressure.

Construction

The illustrated design has a flexible diaphragm separating a process chamber from a sealed evacuated reference chamber. A mechanical or electrical displacement pickup reads diaphragm movement. The vacuum seal, reference stability and temperature compensation form part of the measuring system. Other absolute instruments may use capsules or different transducers; absolute refers to the reference, not a unique elastic shape.

Working

Process pressure deflects the diaphragm against the low reference and the transducer converts displacement to calibrated absolute pressure. A change in atmospheric pressure does not directly redefine this zero as it does for a vented gauge. The sealed reference is not mathematically perfect vacuum; its residual pressure and drift must be sufficiently small or accounted for. Do not add atmosphere again to an already absolute reading.

Applications

Vacuum service, gas-property calculations and processes requiring absolute pressure.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Vacuum-reference leakage or thermal drift changes zero; observe absolute-pressure and overload ratings.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Local atmosphere ને બદલે sealed evacuated space સામે pressure માપતું instrument છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Sensing element process pressure minus ખૂબ ઓછા known reference pressure ને respond કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Drawing માં flexible diaphragm process chamber તથા sealed evacuated reference chamber અલગ રાખે છે. Mechanical/electrical pickup diaphragm movement માપે છે. Vacuum seal, reference stability તથા compensation measuring system ના ભાગ છે. Other designs capsule/અન્ય transducers વાપરે છે. Absolute એટલે reference, કોઈ એક elastic shape નહીં.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Process pressure low reference સામે diaphragm deflect કરે છે અને pickup absolute indication આપે છે. Atmospheric changes vented gauge ની જેમ zero redefine કરતા નથી. Sealed reference mathematically perfect vacuum નથી. Residual pressure/drift ઓછાં હોવા અથવા accounted હોવા જોઈએ. Already absolute reading માં atmosphere ફરી ન ઉમેરો.

ઉપયોગો

Vacuum service, gas-property calculations તથા absolute pressure જરૂરી processes.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Reference leakage/thermal drift zero બદલે છે. Absolute-pressure તથા overload ratings અનુસરો.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

A two-port instrument measuring the difference between two applied pressures.

Principle

A diaphragm or equivalent elastic element deflects under pH−pL.

Construction

High- and low-pressure chambers act on opposite faces of a sensing diaphragm. Two labelled process connections deliver the pressures; an appropriate pickup/linkage produces indication. A manifold may provide isolation, equalization and safe vent/drain functions according to service. Design must withstand both differential pressure and the common static pressure; these are separate ratings.

Working

Both pressures act simultaneously and only their net difference produces the ideal measuring displacement. The instrument is zeroed with the appropriate equal-pressure/reference condition and connected to correctly identified taps. In a filter application, increasing upstream-minus-downstream pressure indicates increasing pressure loss. Impulse-line density/elevation, blocked lines or unequal condensate legs can create false differential pressure even when the process difference is unchanged.

Applications

Filter losses, closed-vessel hydrostatic level and differential-pressure-based measurement.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Do not confuse low differential range with low static-pressure rating. Follow manifold/equalization SOP; incorrect sequencing can overload the diaphragm.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે applied pressures નો તફાવત માપતું two-port instrument છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Diaphragm અથવા equivalent elastic element pH−pL થી deflect થાય છે.

રચના (Construction)

Sensing diaphragm ની બંને બાજુ high/low pressure chambers હોય છે. Labelled ports pressures આપે છે અને pickup/linkage indication આપે છે. Manifold માં service મુજબ isolation, equalization તથા safe vent/drain functions હોઈ શકે છે. Differential તથા common static pressure ratings જુદાં છે; બંને withstand થવા જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

બંને pressures એકસાથે લાગતાં net difference ideal displacement આપે છે. યોગ્ય equal-pressure/reference condition પર zero કરીને labelled taps જોડો. Filter માં upstream-minus-downstream pressure વધે તો pressure loss વધે છે. Impulse-line density/elevation, blockage અથવા unequal condensate legs થી process difference બદલાયા વગર false indication મળી શકે છે.

ઉપયોગો

Filter losses, closed-vessel hydrostatic level તથા differential-pressure-based measurement.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Low differential range ને low static-pressure rating સમાન ન માનો. Manifold/equalization SOP અનુસરો. Wrong sequence diaphragm overload કરી શકે છે.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

An elastic gauge using axial movement of a corrugated hollow bellows.

Principle

Pressure force over an effective area is balanced by bellows elasticity and any added spring.

Construction

A thin-walled corrugated bellows is fixed at one end and free to move axially at the other. The process port applies pressure internally or externally relative to the stated reference. A spring, stops and a lever/pointer or displacement pickup control and indicate travel. The sealed walls and end joints must be compatible with the pressure medium.

Working

Increasing differential pressure produces an axial force that extends or compresses the bellows according to the connection. The moving end drives the pointer through a linkage until restoring force balances the load. Decreasing pressure reverses travel. The relatively large displacement is useful at low pressures, but effective area and elastic stiffness can vary with travel and require calibration.

Applications

Low pressures, vacuum differences and pneumatic instruments of suitable design.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Fatigue, overtravel, temperature and spring hysteresis affect performance; provide rated stops/protection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Corrugated hollow bellows ના axial movement વડે pressure માપતું elastic gauge છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Effective area પર pressure force ને bellows elasticity તથા added spring balance કરે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Thin corrugated bellows નો એક end fixed અને બીજું axially movable હોય છે. Port દ્વારા stated reference સામે internal/external pressure અપાય છે. Spring, stops તથા lever/pointer અથવા pickup travel control/indicate કરે છે. Sealed walls તથા joints pressure medium સાથે compatible હોવા જોઈએ.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Differential pressure વધતાં connection પ્રમાણે bellows extend/compress થાય છે. Moving end linkage વડે pointer ચલાવે છે અને restoring force load ને balance કરે ત્યાં સુધી ખસે છે. Pressure ઘટતાં travel reverse થાય છે. Low pressure પર મોટું displacement મળે છે, પણ effective area/stiffness travel સાથે બદલાતા હોવાથી calibration જોઈએ.

ઉપયોગો

Suitable design માં low pressure, vacuum differences તથા pneumatic instruments.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Fatigue, overtravel, temperature તથા spring hysteresis અસર કરે છે. Rated stops/protection લો.

body.en:
Definition

A pressure gauge comparing hydrostatic liquid-column levels.

Principle

Pressure is balanced by the weight of fluid columns; use signed vertical elevation changes.

Construction

A transparent U-shaped tube contains a suitable manometric liquid and a vertical scale. One limb connects to the process; the other connects to atmosphere for a simple gauge or to a second tap for differential measurement. The selected liquid must be compatible and stable; where multiple liquids are present, their interfaces and densities must be identified. The sketch shows positive gas gauge pressure with negligible gas density.

Working

Process pressure shifts the liquid until column weights balance the applied difference. Read both levels at eye level and take the vertical difference, not tube length. Trace pressure downward by addingρgΔh and upward by subtracting it. For two same-elevation liquid-filled taps, the differential expression includes the density difference between manometric and line liquids; usingρmgh alone would be wrong in that case.

Applications

Low-pressure checks and simple differential-pressure reference measurements.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Slow/awkward for rapidly varying or high pressures; meniscus, tilt, trapped bubbles and liquid compatibility matter. No default mercury use.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hydrostatic liquid-column levels સરખાવી pressure માપતું gauge છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Fluid-column weight pressure ને balance કરે છે. Signed vertical elevation changes લો.

રચના (Construction)

Transparent U-tube માં suitable manometric liquid તથા vertical scale હોય છે. એક limb process અને બીજું simple gauge માટે atmosphere અથવા differential reading માટે second tap સાથે જોડાય છે. Liquid compatible/stable જોઈએ. Multiple liquids હોય તો interfaces/densities ઓળખો. Sketch negligible gas density સાથે positive gas gauge pressure બતાવે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Process pressure liquid shift કરે છે અને column weights difference balance કરે છે. Eye level પર બંને levels વાંચીને vertical difference લો, tube length નહીં. નીચે pressure trace કરતાંρgΔh ઉમેરો અને ઉપર ઘટાડો. Equal-level liquid-filled taps માટે manometric તથા line-liquid density નો difference જોઈએ; તેમાં એકલુંρmgh ખોટું છે.

ઉપયોગો

Low-pressure checks તથા simple differential-pressure reference measurement.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Rapid/high pressure માટે slow/awkward છે. Meniscus, tilt, bubbles તથા compatibility ધ્યાનમાં લો. Mercury default ન લો.

મૂળ સંબંધ / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition

An open vertical tube indicating a liquid’s positive gauge-pressure head.

Principle

At equilibrium, the liquid-column height above the pressure tap supplies hydrostatic head.

Construction

A narrow transparent vertical tube connects to a static wall tap in a liquid line or vessel and remains open to atmosphere at the top. The same liquid rises in the tube. A graduated scale measures height from the tap datum to the free surface. The tap should sense static pressure without facing into the velocity stream; the tube bore must avoid excessive capillary error.

Working

Liquid rises untilρgh balances the tap gauge pressure. Read the vertical free-surface elevation relative to the tap centre and multiply by the liquid density andg. The height is a pressure head, not the velocity head of a Pitot tube. A higher pressure requires a taller column, making the device impractical beyond modest heads.

Applications

Simple positive-pressure head measurement in compatible liquids.

Limitations, selection and precautions

Not suitable for gases, negative gauge pressure or large pressure heads. An open hazardous-liquid column may be unsafe.

Governing relation / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Liquid નું positive gauge-pressure head દર્શાવતી open vertical tube છે.

સિદ્ધાંત

Equilibrium પર pressure tap ઉપર liquid-column height hydrostatic head આપે છે.

રચના (Construction)

Narrow transparent vertical tube liquid line/vessel ના static wall tap સાથે જોડાય છે અને ઉપર atmosphere માટે open છે. Same liquid tube માં ચડે છે. Scale tap datum થી free surface સુધી height માપે છે. Tap velocity stream સામે facing ન હોવો જોઈએ. Bore એટલો નાનો ન લો કે capillary error મોટો થાય.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Liquid એટલું ચડે છે કેρgh tap gauge pressure balance કરે. Tap centre સામે free-surface vertical height વાંચીને density તથા g થી ગુણો. આ pressure head છે, Pitot tube નું velocity head નહીં. Pressure વધતાં વધુ ઊંચી tube જોઈએ તેથી modest head પછી impractical છે.

ઉપયોગો

Compatible liquids માં simple positive-pressure head measurement.

Limitations, પસંદગી તથા Precautions

Gas, negative gauge pressure અથવા large head માટે યોગ્ય નથી. Hazardous liquid ની open column unsafe હોઈ શકે છે.

a.en: Pressure is normal force per area. Gauge pressure is relative to atmosphere, absolute pressure to vacuum, and differential pressure to a second applied pressure.
a.gu: એકમ area દીઠ normal force Pressure છે. Gauge pressure atmosphere સામે, absolute pressure vacuum સામે અને differential pressure બીજા applied pressure સામે લેવાય છે.

a.en: An elastic pressure gauge using deflection of a thin diaphragm. Pressure difference across a flexible diaphragm produces displacement related to the applied pressure.
a.gu: Thin diaphragm ના elastic deflection વડે pressure માપતું gauge છે. Flexible diaphragm ની બંને બાજુના pressure difference થી displacement થાય છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Bourdon-tube pressure gauge.
q.gu: Bourdon-tube Pressure Gauge ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A mechanical gauge using the elastic uncoiling of a curved, noncircular-section tube. Internal pressure tends to round the flattened cross-section and straighten the curved tube.
a.gu: Curved noncircular-section tube ના elastic uncoiling વડે pressure માપતું mechanical gauge છે. Internal pressure flattened section ને વધુ round કરીને curved tube ને straighten કરવાની tendency આપે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Dead-weight pressure gauge / tester.
q.gu: Dead-weight Pressure Gauge / Tester ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A pressure-standard device balancing fluid pressure against known force on a calibrated piston area. At floating equilibrium, pressure times effective piston area balances the applied load.
a.gu: Calibrated piston area પર known force ને fluid pressure સાથે balance કરતું pressure-standard device છે. Floating equilibrium પર pressure×effective piston area applied load ને balance કરે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Strain-gauge pressure transducer.
q.gu: Strain-gauge Pressure Transducer ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A pressure instrument converting elastic strain into a resistance change and electrical output. A bonded strain element changes resistance when the pressure-sensing member deforms. A bridge detects the small change.
a.gu: Elastic strain ને resistance change તથા electrical output માં ફેરવતું pressure instrument છે. Pressure-sensing member deform થાય ત્યારે bonded strain element ની resistance બદલાય છે. Bridge નાનો change detect કરે છે.

q.en: State the definition and principle of Capsule pressure gauge.
q.gu: Capsule Pressure Gauge ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A sensitive elastic gauge using two joined diaphragms forming a hollow capsule. A pressure difference expands or contracts the capsule axially.
a.gu: બે joined diaphragms થી બનેલા hollow capsule વડે low pressure માપતું sensitive elastic gauge છે. Pressure difference થી capsule axially expand/contract થાય છે.

a.en: A pressure instrument referenced to a sealed evacuated space rather than local atmosphere. A sensing element responds to process pressure minus a very low, known reference pressure.
a.gu: Local atmosphere ને બદલે sealed evacuated space સામે pressure માપતું instrument છે. Sensing element process pressure minus ખૂબ ઓછા known reference pressure ને respond કરે છે.

q.gu: Differential Pressure Gauge ની વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A two-port instrument measuring the difference between two applied pressures. A diaphragm or equivalent elastic element deflects under pH−pL.
a.gu: બે applied pressures નો તફાવત માપતું two-port instrument છે. Diaphragm અથવા equivalent elastic element pH−pL થી deflect થાય છે.

a.gu: Corrugated hollow bellows ના axial movement વડે pressure માપતું elastic gauge છે. Effective area પર pressure force ને bellows elasticity તથા added spring balance કરે છે.
